title: Outstanding!
text: We were in the fence if we would spend our one extra day in Barcelona going on this excursion. So glad we chose to go. It was one of our favorites places! Our guide Vladi, was excellent. He allowed us to tailor our trip to how we wanted to spend our time at Montserrat. He was very informative throughout and very personable, taking care to ensure we were enjoying the adventure. Highly recommend this excursion and our guide, Vladi.
author: Monica_L

title: Wonderful hike of...
text: Wonderful hike of Monserrat. Guide was patient, modified the experience and assisted when needed for physical safety. Moderate hike.
author: Suzanne_S

title: Montserrat Hiking Tour
text: Vladi was friendly, experienced and provided a beautiful hiking tour at Montserrat. We had a great experience and will definitely tour again with Vladi!
author: JACKIE_C

title: Montserrat with Vladi
text: Vladi was a wonderfull guide, he has a lot experence and knowlage. the hike in Montserrat is absolutly recomended before leaving Barcelona.
author: BarcelonaWalking
